You are resolving an in-progress git merge in treams-rs (branch claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh). It merges commit e32b28b (condensed into 8251007) ("PA2": PyO3 object/context bindings refactor in crates/treams-py/src/*.rs and python/treams_rs/_native.pyi — generic one-use residual helpers, shared conversions, negative-stride fix for borrowed S-matrix blocks, stride-agnostic 1-D inputs, real cotangents for real outputs, a table-driven native-context contract test, retirement of test-only lattice bindings, stub fixes) into the integration branch, which already contains the Python test-lane work (PB0 foundation with tests/_support.py + category markers; PB1/PB2/PB3 test rewrites), RB1 (Rust core waves/coordinates/polar changes), PA1 (ufunc bindings) and others. Do not abort the merge.

Conflicted: crates/treams-py/src/basis.rs, tests/test_channels.py, test_coordinates.py, test_fractional_legendre.py, test_internal_bands.py, test_lattice.py, test_particle_cluster.py, test_smatrix_power_adjoints.py, test_vectorwaves.py (check git status for the full list).

Rules:

  • Rust binding conflicts (basis.rs): keep PA2's binding structure (its shared helpers) and make it compile against the integration branch's treams-core API (RB1 may have changed core signatures). Keep behaviour identical to both sides' intent.
  • Tests: keep the test lanes' rewrites (check_pullback use, new invariants, markers, _support helpers) AND PA2's intent (its per-file context-contract tests were deliberately replaced by the table-driven registry test; its layout regression tests; tests moved from removed test-only bindings to the public path). Inspect each side with git log --oneline -p MERGE_HEAD --not HEAD -- <file> and git log -p HEAD --not MERGE_HEAD -- <file>. Never drop an assertion that guards a real fix; drop a test only if it is genuinely covered elsewhere after the merge (say where in the commit message).
  • PA2 fixed the negative-stride S-matrix binding bug. The test lanes pinned that bug with strict xfails (reason mentions negative strides / flipped layouts, e.g. in tests/test_internal_bands.py and tests/test_smatrix_power_adjoints.py, and possibly listed in docs/status.md 'expected failures'). With xfail_strict=true they will XPASS-fail: convert them to plain passing tests and remove the corresponding defect entry from docs/status.md if one exists. Likewise for any other strict xfail that PA2 fixed (e.g. real/NumPy-scalar cotangents for 0-d/real outputs).
  • Every test must carry a registered category marker (physics, ad_contract, python_contract, public_e2e, oracle_numerical); tests/test_suite_contract.py guards it.
  • If _native.pyi or public docstrings changed, run uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py and include regenerated docs.

Verification (must all pass before committing): cd treams-rs && just build-ext (target is cold, a few minutes), cargo fmt --check --all, PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/ruff check ., uv run --no-sync pyrefly check, uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py --check, the full uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, and the parity battery PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python .venv/bin/python battery.py compare baseline.npz (must PASS). Commit the merge with message "Merge PA2: object and context bindings" plus a short body on the resolutions, ending with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com Claude-Session: [link to a conversation in the cloud] Do NOT push; do not touch scratch: lanes or other branches. Report each conflict's resolution, xfails converted, and the verification results.

The PA2 merge (e32b28b (condensed into 8251007)) is committed on claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh as e0f763f (condensed into 8251007) "Merge PA2: object and context bindings", with the requested trailers. Nothing was pushed, and scratch: lanes and other branches were not touched. Every verification step passed.

How each conflict was resolved

  • crates/treams-py/src/basis.rs: I kept PA2's structure (detached(...) plus finish_rotation) and pass &to, &source, because RB1 changed treams_core::rotation::spherical to take references.
    • PA2's finish_expansion moves the matrix out of the residual. I checked that this is still safe against the new core: the translation and cylindrical expansion pullbacks check cotangent shapes against the bases, not the stored value. Only the periodic pullbacks read the value, and those are not affected.
  • tests/test_internal_bands.py: I took the lanes' version (fixed draw, every LAYOUTS entry with 1 and 4 columns, check_pullback/check_gradient imports) and removed the strict _NEGATIVE_STRIDES xfails.
    • PA2's arranged cotangent (residual.pullback(arrange(g, layout))) is kept.
    • The regression history is now a comment on the test.
    • I also removed _support.FLIPPED_LAYOUTS, whose only consumer was that xfail selection.
  • tests/test_smatrix_power_adjoints.py: imports both check_gradient (lanes) and check_pullback (PA2). PA2's layout test and real-cotangent test are kept. PA2 deleted a per-file context test here; that is covered by the smatrix_transmittance entry in tests/test_native_contexts.py.
  • tests/test_particle_cluster.py: kept the lanes' helpers and imports and dropped the now-unused assert_one_use_context import. PA2's deleted context test is covered by the particle_cluster and cylindrical_particle_cluster entries in tests/test_native_contexts.py.
  • tests/test_lattice.py: I combined the two sides.
    • PA2's _record, evaluate and derivatives now go through the public diff.lattice_sum, since PA2 removed _native.lattice_sum and _native.lattice_derivatives.
    • They use the lanes' signature, where q sets the dimension.
    • All lane invariants (skewed cells, Bloch periodicity, inversion parity, tiny-shift xfails) and PA2's finite-difference and Euler assertions are kept.
  • tests/test_channels.py: kept the lanes' comparison against a fresh record and its tolerances. I dropped finite_match="values" because PA2's shared binding message now says "finite", and updated the stale comment.
  • tests/test_coordinates.py, tests/test_fractional_legendre.py, tests/test_vectorwaves.py: marker-only conflicts. I kept both sides' markers (python_contract and/or oracle_numerical) on each test.

Xfails converted

  • All 11 strict negative-stride xfails in test_internal_bands.py::test_internal_borrowed_forward_and_owned_adjoint are now plain tests, and all 22 cases pass.
  • The integration side of test_smatrix_power_adjoints.py had no strict xfail.
  • docs/status.md never listed the stride defect, so it needed no change. Its six listed defects are all core issues and still fail as expected.
  • No other strict xfail passed unexpectedly. The single XPASS in the run is the non-strict JAX flush-to-zero case in test_framework_physics, which depends on random draws and has nothing to do with PA2.

Verification

  • just build-ext (cold build): OK.
  • cargo fmt --check --all: OK.
  • cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -D warnings: OK.
  • ruff format --check and ruff check: OK.
  • pyrefly check: 0 errors.
  • generate_agent_docs.py --check: "Agent documentation is current". The auto-merged docs/api.md was already correct, so there was nothing to regenerate.
  • Full pytest: 4269 passed, 36 skipped, 26 xfailed, 1 xpassed.
  • Parity battery: PASS (128 cases, 0 failing, largest error 1.67e-15).
